map.15°C 海平面声速约 340 m/s。: At 15°C sea level the speed of sound is about 340 m/s.
map.由速度 V 与当地音速 a=√(γRT) 算马赫数 M=V/a，判断亚/跨/超音: Compute the Mach number M=V/a from the speed V and the local speed of sound a=√(γRT) to judge subsonic/transonic/supersonic.
map.对比不同温度/高度下的音速，看同一真速对应的马赫数。: Compare the speed of sound at different temperatures/altitudes to see the Mach number for the same true speed.
map.评估跨音速阻力激增（音障）风险。: Assess the risk of the transonic drag rise (sound barrier).
map.=1.4、气体常数 R=287 J/(kg·K)。音速 a=√(1.4×287×: =1.4 and gas constant R=287 J/(kg·K). Speed of sound a=√(1.4×287×288)≈340 m/s. If the flight speed V=340 m/s, then M=1.0 (exactly the speed of sound).
map.音速为什么随温度变化？: Why does the speed of sound change with temperature?
map.a=√(γRT)，温度越高音速越大。高空虽稀薄但更冷，音速反而略低；所以同一真速: a=√(γRT), so the higher the temperature, the greater the speed of sound. The upper atmosphere is thin but colder, so the speed of sound is actually slightly lower; hence the same true speed corresponds to a higher Mach number at altitude, which is why transonic conditions are defined by Mach rather than true speed.
map.M=1 就一定是音障吗？: Is M=1 necessarily the sound barrier?
map.M=1 是音速点，但阻力剧增出现在 M≈0.8–1.2 的跨音速区（局部激波）。: M=1 is the speed-of-sound point, but the sharp drag rise occurs in the transonic region M≈0.8-1.2 (local shock waves). Modern airliners cruise at M≈0.78-0.85, deliberately avoiding the strong shock region to save fuel.
